result.description:
SNB Holdings WA Pty Ltd (trading as Escape Civil) is seeking experienced and motivated Concreters to join our growing team in the Pilbara.
We deliver a range of civil, commercial and industrial projects for major clients across the region. If you take pride in producing quality work, enjoy working outdoors and want long-term employment with a supportive team, we'd love to hear from you.

About the Role
Your day-to-day duties will include:
•	Preparing sites, including excavation, compaction and formwork.
•	Placing, screeding, finishing and curing concrete.
•	Installing and tying reinforcing steel and mesh.
•	Operating concreting tools and equipment safely.
•	Reading and working from site plans and supervisor instructions.
•	Assisting with general civil construction and labouring tasks as required.
•	Maintaining a clean, safe and organised worksite.
•	Working closely with supervisors and fellow team members to deliver high-quality results.

What We're Looking For
•	Minimum 12 months' full-time concreting experience.
•	Experience in concrete finishing, formwork and steel fixing.
•	Strong work ethic and attention to detail.
•	Physically fit and capable of working in Pilbara conditions.
•	Commitment to workplace health and safety.
•	Reliable, punctual and able to work well in a team.
•	Ability to pass a pre-employment medical and drug & alcohol screen.
•	Current White Card (Construction Induction) - essential.
•	Current driver's licence (preferred).

What We Offer
•	Competitive hourly rates of $40-$55, based on experience.
•	Ongoing full-time employment.
•	Opportunity to work on varied civil, commercial and industrial projects.
•	Supportive management and a positive team culture.
•	Career development and opportunities to grow with the business.
•	Immediate start available for the right candidate.

Apply Now
If you're ready to join a hardworking team and build your career with Escape Civil, we'd love to hear from you.
result.title: Concreter (Full-Time)

result.description: Barbie Nails & Beauty  As the Beauty Salon Manager, you will be responsible for managing the salon’s day-to-day operations, supervising staff,  coordinating appointments, maintaining service standards, and supporting the overall performance of the  business. This is a hands-on leadership role suited to an organised and proactive manager who can effectively  manage a busy salon offering nail, beauty, lash, waxing, and massage services.    Benefits  ? Competitive salary of $80,000–$85,000 per year, excluding superannuation  ? Full-time employment in an established South Perth salon  ? Supportive and friendly working environment  ? Staff discounts on selected salon services and products  ? The opportunity to lead a diverse salon team and contribute to the continued growth of Barbie Nails & Beauty   Task & responsibilities  ? Manage the salon’s daily operations and ensure efficient service delivery  ? Coordinate online bookings, appointments, walk-in clients, and treatment schedules  ? Prepare staff rosters and allocate work according to bookings and employee skills  ? Recruit, train, supervise, and support salon employees  ? Lead nail technicians, beauty therapists, lash technicians and support staff  ? Monitor staff attendance, productivity, performance, and customer service standards  ? Ensure nail, beauty, lash, waxing, and massage treatments are delivered consistently and professionally  ? Maintain high levels of client satisfaction and respond to enquiries, feedback, and complaints  ? Monitor salon sales, operating expenses, service targets, and business performance  ?
